parsed.rationale: The eight members in this cluster span four unrelated packages (Playback, DebugPanel, Wallpaper, Intents) and cover entirely distinct domain concepts: audio streaming state (StreamingAudioState, PlayerState, PlaybackState, PlaybackError), thermal-state display helpers (ProcessInfo.ThermalState extensions in DebugPanel and Wallpaper), a test-local timeout sentinel (TimeoutError in MP3StreamDecoderTests.swift), and an intent-layer error type (IntentError in Intents/IntentUtilities.swift). The structural signal is that all share 'shared_field_count: 1' with empty fields_or_signature lists — meaning the similarity is purely that each is a zero-member extension or type-alias shell, not that they encode the same concept. Consolidating these would conflate unrelated domain boundaries and create an artificial cross-package dependency. The ProcessInfo.ThermalState duplication between DebugPanel and Wallpaper is the only pair worth a separate, targeted review, but even there the Wallpaper copy lives under Examples/WallpaperSampleApp, making it a sample-app mirror rather than a true production duplicate.
